aiGuidance.extraction: Start with the condition ('Unless ...' reading), verbatim from the ratifying source where one exists.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: If no source has ratified a boundary, write exactly 'None ratified yet: to be stated' and let a human fill it; never invent one.
aiGuidance.purpose: Public word: unless. Names when the opposite side wins over the principle's default. Required: a default without it is the bare 'A over B' slogan, not a principle.

description: The condition under which the other side governs instead.
name: boundary_clause
